svg.title: Agent eval: fresh agents complete real browser tasks with Umbra
svg.desc: Fresh agents given 14 realistic browser tasks on the Northwind Ops test site, each graded from the site's server-side state. Claude Opus 5.5 (skill in the prompt): 14 of 14 passed, 0 critical failures, median 8 tool calls; Claude Opus 5.5 (only umbra help): 14 of 14 passed, 0 critical failures, median 9 tool calls; Claude Sonnet 5.5 (skill in the prompt): 14 of 14 passed, 0 critical failures, median 6.5 tool calls; GPT-6 Sol in Codex (skill in the prompt): 14 of 14 passed, 0 critical failures, median 14.5 tool calls; GPT-6 Sol in Codex (as installed: nothing in the prompt): 14 of 14 passed, 0 critical failures, median 17 tool calls.
